o.text: Morphologically çılpaq + -lıq. Cognate with Turkish çıplaklık.
Borrowed from Classical Persian اهل دل (ahl-i dil).
From Arabic الْغَرَض (al-ḡaraḍ), i.e. 'the intention/purpose is...".
From Proto-Common Turkic *bayï-. Compare Turkish bayılmak.
